title: Make the first producer report list every criterion with evidence
summary: Goal: stop the producer's first report from missing acceptance criteria, which costs the user a 9–17 minute second run. Fix the cause in the change producer prompt and the rendered brief (not the budget-tight shared prompt), then measure the send-back rate before and after from job records.

defaults_applied.how: Add tests in athena-context and athena-core; cargo test and clippy must be clean.
The finding cites file locations; the rates are marked measured or estimate, with sample size.
Behavior criteria check that the brief and the send-back logic behave as intended, not that text exists.
The finding names which of prompt, schema or display causes the misses before the fix.
The before and after send-back rates are the outcome criterion.
The decision note is written for an outside reader.
One focused change to the brief, the change producer prompt and, if needed, the field docs.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Audience: the user, who pays for the send-back, and the verifier who judges the change.

Read in this copy: run.rs unmet_criteria already ignores numbering, kind tag, case, spacing and trailing punctuation, but any other wording difference counts as unmet. A paraphrased or merged entry therefore triggers a send-back, and the send-back message may only restate what was done.

Read in this copy: the shared producer.md has one line on criteria_check, and the CriterionCheckOutput schema asks for the text 'without its number or kind tag'. The producer must retype criteria from memory, so wording drifts. Rendering the criteria so they can be copied verbatim is the likely fix.

Records of the named jobs are absent from my copy, so the cause is not yet measured. The producer must read the records, if it can, to confirm the cause and compute the before rate for the six jobs. If it cannot read them, it names that gap and does not invent numbers.
The after rate can only come from jobs run after the change. The change reports this honestly as a small sample or as not yet measurable, and gives a repeatable way to compute it.

Per the user's reply, new producer instructions go in crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md or the rendered brief in briefs.rs, net of removals. The shared producer.md is not grown (study at 1276/1300). The change verifier prompt is not touched (1298/1300).
The design call and alternatives (prompt only, schema only, tolerant matching) are recorded in docs/decisions.md.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/decisions.md has a note naming the cause of the missed criteria. It cites crates/athena-core/src/run.rs (unmet_criteria, criterion_key), the criteria rendering in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, the producer prompts, and the CriterionCheckOutput docs in outputs.rs. It says which of prompt, schema and display contributed and lists the alternatives considered (prompt only, schema only, tolerant matching).

The note states the send-back rate before the change for kb23, c2h3, 7qht, 0qcy, c4w4 and skh5, with the records read to get it. Each number is marked measured or estimate, with its sample size. Any unreadable record is named, and the after rate is stated for jobs run after the change, or the note says there are none yet.

Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: a test shows the rendered producer brief lists every accepted criterion verbatim, with a copyable form (no number or kind tag needed to match), and instructs one criteria_check entry per criterion, in order, with evidence, including criteria already satisfied.

New producer instructions are in crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md or the rendered brief. Shared crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md and crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md are not made longer, and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture` passes.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: a test shows a first report with a met entry for every criterion is not sent back, and a report omitting one criterion is sent back once, with the send-back naming the missing criterion's exact text.
Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass.

out_of_scope: Adding to the change verifier prompt (at 1298 of 1300 tokens)
Growing the shared producer.md beyond its budget
Changing the verifier or planner behavior
Editing records/ or the named jobs' outputs
departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: this adds code, tests in two crates, a budget check and a records-measurement step. The before/after measurement depends on records that may be unreadable, which lowers the chance of passing.
